title: Traveller Profile
description: A traveller's durable preferences. Split into fixed_preferences (always apply) and ask_per_trip (collected per trip). Stored per-user, outside the plugin repo.

profile_name.description: Name/label for this profile (e.g. 'default', a person, or a group).

fixed_preferences.description: Always apply these to every trip.

dietary_restrictions.description: Hard rules — vegetarian/vegan/allergies/etc. Use 'none' if unrestricted.

dietary_preferences.description: Likes/dislikes — cuisines, coffee, alcohol, local-specialty appetite.

photography.description: Camera and photography interests, if any.

activities.description: Durable activity likes (hikes, drives, water sports, etc.).

flights.description: Home airport(s), airline loyalty, and flexibility.

lodging_structure.description: How lodging should be presented (default: neighbourhood + 2-3 suggested properties + rationale, no prices).

ask_per_trip.description: Vary by trip — the planner asks these in Phase 1 rather than assuming.

lodging_style_framework.description: Optional rules mapping trip type -> lodging style, used when asking per trip.
